# Loopa

> Loopa is an iOS app that reminds contraceptive ring users when to insert and remove their
> ring. It sends insistent reminders that repeat until confirmed, shows a live countdown widget
> on the Home Screen and Lock Screen, keeps a fully editable history, and provides a guided
> protocol if a date is missed.

## Who it's for

People who use the vaginal contraceptive ring (e.g. NuvaRing-type devices) and want a private,
reliable reminder — not a generic period or pill tracker.

## Key facts

- Platform: iOS (iPhone). Not available on Android.
- Price: free to download, with a Loopa Pro subscription (3-day free trial, then 19.99€/year,
  auto-renewing).
- Privacy: 100% local. No account, no server, no third-party SDK. Data never leaves the device
  (optional private iCloud backup only).
- Supported ring schedules: standard 21-days-in/7-days-out, continuous use (28 days, no break),
  and fully custom durations.
- Not a medical device and not a substitute for medical advice.

## FAQ

Q: How effective is the contraceptive ring?
A: With perfect timing, the ring is about 99.7% effective (CDC data). Typical use (accounting
for timing mistakes) is lower, around 93%. Loopa's core purpose is closing that gap by making
timing mistakes harder to make.

Q: Does Loopa collect any data?
A: No. Loopa stores everything locally on the user's iPhone. There is no account, server, or
analytics SDK.

Q: Where can I download Loopa?
A: On the Apple App Store (iPhone only).
